entities.name: Grover
entities.description: An Ironroot Treefolk who ran a tavern in the Red Iron Mountains of Aerona, known for giving advice and provisions to adventurers.

entities.name: Grover's
entities.description: A tavern and wayhouse run by Grover that attracts diverse patrons, many abandoned by dueling planeswalkers.

entities.name: Red Iron Mountains
entities.description: Mountains in Aerona where Grover's tavern is located.

entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: Part of the Domains of Dominaria, containing the Red Iron Mountains.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Aerona lies.

entities.name: Dreadfang
entities.description: Leader of the Crookshank kobolds; killed by Kyyrao Grrenmw, later reanimated.

entities.name: Crookshank kobolds
entities.description: A troop of kobolds who frequented Grover's and ate him out of everything.

entities.name: Kyyrao Grrenmw
entities.description: A patron of Grover's who snapped Dreadfang's neck and later joined Loot's trip.

entities.name: Loot Niptil
entities.description: A patron of Grover's whom Dreadfang wanted to join him on a trip.

entities.name: Corsen Mon Duur
entities.description: A patron of Grover's whose family was captured by the reanimated Dreadfang.

entities.name: Shinra
entities.description: A patron of Grover's who joined Loot on the venture.

entities.name: Anaytha
entities.description: A woman rumored to closely resemble Loot Niptil.

entities.name: Peregrinator Complex
entities.description: The place where Anaytha was to be sought out.

events.summary: Around 4000 AR, Crookshank kobolds led by Dreadfang began frequenting Grover's and eating him out of everything.
events.quote: a bunch of Crookshank kobolds began frequenting Grover's and eating him out of everything

events.summary: Kyyrao Grrenmw snapped Dreadfang's neck, ending the spat with the kobolds.
events.quote: The spat temporarily ended when Kyyrao Grrenmw snapped Dreadfang's neck.

events.summary: A year later a reanimated Dreadfang captured Corsen Mon Duur's family and sent him to convince Loot Niptil to seek Anaytha.
events.quote: One year later, a reanimated Dreadfang captured Corsen Mon Duur

events.summary: Grover gave Loot, Kyyrao and Shinra provisions for their trip to the Peregrinator Complex.
events.quote: Grover provided them with no words of wisdom, but did give them provisions for the trip.

relations.quote: Grover was an Ironroot Treefolk who ran a tavern simply called Grover's
